description: Everything FactorRoute has verified about invoice factoring in one US state or DC: commercial financing disclosure law (status, threshold, citation, whether it covers factoring, APR, registration), where UCC liens are filed and searched, how fast state agencies must pay vendors and the late-payment interest, private construction prompt pay, mechanics lien and payment bond deadlines, the main industries and payers, and sources.
